name: RabbitMQ
summary: A message broker that routes published messages through exchanges into queues, delivers them to consumers with acknowledgements, and applies flow control under load.

features.name: Exchange-to-queue routing
features.description: RabbitMQ publishers send messages to exchanges, which route them to queues according to exchange type, bindings, routing keys, and arguments. Consumers read messages from queues rather than directly from publishers.
benefits: Supports direct, topic, fanout, and header-based routing patterns
Allows multiple queues to receive independently routed copies
costs: Bindings and routing keys become distributed configuration
Unroutable or misrouted messages require explicit handling
Additional broker stages add latency and operational state

features.name: Durable queue and message state
features.description: RabbitMQ queues can be durable and messages can be persistent, subject to the documented durability and acknowledgement conditions. Queue state therefore spans transient delivery state and optionally recoverable broker state.
benefits: Makes retention and delivery durability explicit per topology
costs: Persistence adds disk I/O and recovery time
Durability settings do not replace end-to-end data safety or consumer idempotency
Queue accumulation consumes storage and can amplify backlog effects

features.name: Consumer acknowledgements and redelivery
features.description: Consumers can acknowledge, reject, or negatively acknowledge deliveries. Unacknowledged messages can be requeued or dead-lettered according to configuration, making delivery completion distinct from broker transmission.
benefits: Lets consumers control completion after processing
Provides a visible boundary for at-least-once processing
costs: Unacked deliveries consume consumer and broker resources
Ordering and retry behavior can change under failures and competing consumers

features.name: Publisher confirms and flow control
features.description: RabbitMQ offers publisher confirms for broker acceptance and applies resource-driven flow control to limit publishers when queues, memory, or disk become constrained. These mechanisms expose distinct stages of message progress.
benefits: Provides feedback for publish reliability decisions
Prevents unbounded resource pressure from silently expanding
Allows producers to coordinate throughput with broker capacity
costs: Confirm latency and flow pauses reduce peak producer throughput
Acceptance by the broker does not mean business processing completed
Backpressure behavior must be incorporated into retry and timeout policy

mathematical_views.question: Which queues receive a published message under exchange type, bindings, routing keys, and topology state?
assumptions: Exchanges, bindings, queues, publishers, and consumers form a directed graph
Routing is modeled as a deterministic function of message metadata and binding state
The view separates routing acceptance from consumer processing
The model does not infer delivery when the target queue is deleted or unavailable

mathematical_views.question: How do publish confirmation, queueing, delivery, acknowledgement, rejection, redelivery, and flow control advance message state?
assumptions: A message has distinct broker-acceptance, queued, delivered, and settled states
Consumer acknowledgement is modeled as an explicit transition after application processing
Failures can return a delivery to a queue or a dead-letter path
The model does not claim exactly-once effects for external consumers

benefits: Flexible topology decouples publishers from consumers
costs: Routing configuration and failure handling become operationally significant

benefits: Optional persistence buffers failures and restarts
costs: Disk cost, recovery time, and backlog growth trade against durability

benefits: Processing completion and retry policy remain under consumer control
costs: At-least-once delivery requires idempotency and can reorder work

benefits: Producers receive acceptance feedback and bounded resource pressure
costs: Confirm waits and flow pauses couple producer throughput to broker health
